title: Economists Launch Initiative for a Real-World Focused Economy
seoTitle: Economists Push for Practical, Real-World Economics
subtitle: Over a hundred economists unite to promote an economic approach centered on everyday needs
excerpt: Over 100 economists create a movement aiming to align economic theory with the real-life experiences of individuals, making the discipline more relevant.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A group of over one hundred economists has launched an initiative aimed at reorienting the economic discipline towards the everyday issues faced by people. The movement seeks to bridge economic theory with society's practical demands, proposing analyses and policies that genuinely reflect the reality experienced by citizens.

Objectives of the Proposal

Among other goals, the proposal aims to make economic debates more relevant to daily life, encouraging studies that consider factors such as cost of living, access to basic services, and working conditions. The initiative also seeks to foster communication among researchers, policymakers, and the general public, thereby creating a more direct space for dialogue.

Structure and Participation

The list of participants includes economists from various fields, who have organized themselves using public spreadsheets to coordinate actions and share resources. This collaborative structure enables members to contribute ideas, documents, and proposals in an open and transparent manner.

With information from Agência Brasil.
